scope: Inherited physical contracts retained; finite affine 3x3 block. No complete physical remainder claimed.
capacity_statement: Every PSD Rhat <= diag(strict_directed_R11_capacity, 0.1) is carried uniformly by the refined bank enclosure. This is a budget, not an attained physical remainder bound.
proof: All 256 vertices of the conservative primitive entry box give a positive affine 3x3 block at R=0. For fixed R22=0.1 its positive (2,3) subblock gives the displayed exact R11 capacity. Convexity extends both certificates to the entire box.
